scenes.headline: What's inside Qwen3.8's open 2.4-trillion-parameter model
scenes.sub: Read from config.json, the weight index and the FP8 exclusion list.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Olive! Qwen3.8's two point four trillion parameter model is out, with no technical report. So let's rebuild it from its own files.

scenes.text: Rebuild the model from its own files, and it's nearly all routed experts. The FP8 checkpoint quantizes those, and nothing else.

steps.say: The card gives the stack in one line: three Gated DeltaNet layers, then one gated attention layer, each followed by a mixture of experts. Twenty-three times.

steps.note: a fixed-size recurrent state, no KV cache
steps.say: DeltaNet layers keep a fixed-size state, not a KV cache, so only the twenty-three attention layers grow with context.
On top, the multi-token prediction block is a whole extra layer, with its own five hundred and twelve experts. Twenty-six point four billion parameters.

scenes.label: of the model is routed experts, summed from the config
scenes.note: the rebuilt total lands within 1.6M parameters of the weight index
scenes.say: Add it all up and you land within a whisker of the weight index. Ninety-seven point nine seven percent of the model is routed experts.

scenes.title: What the FP8 checkpoint actually converts

steps.say: Now open the FP8 config. Only the routed experts become FP8, at one byte each.
Attention, every DeltaNet projection, the shared expert and router, the embeddings and the MTP block all stay at sixteen bits.

steps.note: one step up here removed 11% of the remaining divergence
steps.say: Three parties agree about DeltaNet: both Qwen configs spare it, and an outside quantizer found extra precision there removed eleven percent of the remaining divergence.

scenes.text: In a hybrid DeltaNet model, the linear-attention path is the precision-critical part. That is where the bits go.

recap: 23 blocks of three DeltaNet, one attention
97.97% routed experts, the only part in FP8
The DeltaNet path is where precision matters
scenes.say: To recap: a three-to-one hybrid, almost all experts, and a DeltaNet path worth keeping precise.
